chore(fetch): bump certifi to 2026.10.23 in uv.lock

certifi 2026.10.23 removes the eMudhra roots emSign Root CA - C1 and
emSign ECC Root CA - C3 after the October 20 key-compromise disclosure.
The fetch Dockerfile installs with uv sync --locked, so an image built
from this repository trusted both roots until this lock moved.

Closes #5340

test(filesystem): explicit timeout on the 100000-entry walk tests

test(filesystem): give the 100000-entry walk tests an explicit timeout

The bounded-walk cap tests walk MAX_WALK_ENTRIES + 1 mocked entries on
purpose, so their cost scales with the runner. On a loaded Windows
runner the search_files one crossed vitest's 5 s default and turned
v2/main red. Give the three cap tests a 30 s timeout, with the reason
beside it; no retry, and the real bound is still the one tested.

Fixes #5328. Approach also proposed by FelixFangX in that issue.
